messages:
Alina: quick postmortem follow-up: root cause was a schema rename + one ETL worker backlog causing aggregator drops. want clear owners and short deadlines so this doesn't repeat.
Theo: agree. split into: (a) ETL backlog/worker fixes (b) aggregator reconciliation + alerting (c) pre-deploy schema checks.
Omar: I'll take ETL worker investigation. initial plan: reproduce backlog with `./infra/etl/load_test --shards 10 --rate 5000` and check queue latency. ETA: 2024-11-02.
Priya: I'll own alerts & incident policy. propose two signals: aggregator_delta_1h_pct and span_coverage_15m. PD: escalate to obs on P1 if delta>2% for 15m.
Li: I'll implement reconciliation job and dashboard. job: hourly diff on 1h windows, persist top-100 deltas. ETA: 2024-11-04.
Alina: Concrete actions I want in the postmortem doc: 1) ETL worker restart/runbook - Omar - 11/02 2) Reconcile job + dashboard - Li - 11/04 3) Sampling/config audit for ingest clients - Theo - 11/05 4) Pre-deploy schema quick-check CI - Riley (cc) - 11/08 5) Backfill plan for affected keys - Omar/Li - 11/07
Theo: sampling audit note: mobile SDKs were using legacy sampler=0.01 while server had 0.05. will standardize defaults and add compatibility test.
Omar: repro logs: `tail -n 200 /var/log/etl/worker-s3.log | grep "retry"` shows retry spikes aligned with GC pauses. investigating node metrics now.
eng-oncall-bot: scheduled: rolling restart of etl-workers by Omar on 2024-11-02 03:00 UTC. rollback if error rate >1.5% within 10m.
Li: reconcile SQL I'll use (short): ```sql
-- aggregate delta per key
select key, sum(raw) as raw_total, sum(agg) as agg_total, sum(raw)-sum(agg) as delta
from (
  select key, sum(count) as raw from raw_events where ts between :start and :end group by key
) r
join (
  select key, sum(count) as agg from aggregator where ts between :start and :end group by key
) a using (key)
order by delta desc
limit 200;
```
Priya: alert thresholds: aggregator_delta_pct (1h) warn at 0.5%, page at 2% sustained 15m. span_coverage: warn at 85%, page at 65% for 15m.
Alina: pre-deploy check: CI job runs reconcile on a 3m canary sample; if key delta >0 for core keys, block deploy and notify owner. owner: Riley to add to cicd.
Theo: also recommend a cheap schema-lint that checks removed/renamed fields used as aggregator keys. I'll draft a rule set.
Omar: backfill plan: snapshot restore for windows >72h, stream-replay for <72h. estimate cost for 7d backfill ~120 CPU-hours; will add to PR.
Li: dashboard tweak: plot 95p delta over 1h and absolute delta; set alert to combine pct and absolute thresholds. ETA dashboard: 2024-11-04.
Priya: process cadence: weekly 30m check until all actions closed. rotating lead: Li, Omar, Theo, Priya, Alina. first sync: 2024-11-06.
Alina: please convert items to GH issues and tag milestone `obs-fix-nov24`. I'll create milestone and umbrella issue.
Omar: created issue for ETL investigation: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4981
Li: opened ticket for reconcile job and dashboard: https://github.com/redwood/platform/issues/3122
eng-oncall-bot: reminder: weekly obs follow-up scheduled 2024-11-06 09:00 UTC. attendees: Li, Omar, Theo, Priya, Alina.
Theo: final note: watch for deploys that include schema migrations; add a quick checklist to release notes so teams don't forget.
Alina: thanks all. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners + deadlines and close the loop when tasks move to Done. ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
